pages.title: Load and Crank
pages.text: Use ingredients on the quern, then empty-hand right-click to turn the crank. Default work per crank is five. Empty-hand use collects ready output first. Sneak-empty-hand use retrieves unfinished input.

pages.title: Bulk Milling
pages.text: Four Wheat make four Flour for 60 work: twelve default cranks. Four Raw Ochre make eight Ground Ochre for 60 work. One Brick makes two Grog for 40 work. Copper Fasteners gate the quern; the mortar is available earlier.

pages.title: Automation
pages.text: Item handlers load and extract but do not crank. Collect waiting output before processing another batch. Packs can define counts, work values, outputs, and recipe priority. A running animation is feedback for manual work, not powered milling.
